name: Standard Miting Notes
description: The default recap: summary, decisions, action items, and highlights.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: One tight paragraph a person who missed the miting can rely on: what it was about, what changed, and what happens next. Use only what the transcript supports — no invented context, names, or dates.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: Decisions actually made, phrased to stand alone ('We will X' rather than 'discussed X'). Exclude options that were only debated. If no decisions were made, write 'No decisions made.'

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Every task someone agreed to do. Extract the owner from who accepted the task (use their name as spoken; '—' if unclear) and the due date only if one was said. Write one checklist item per task and end it with the timestamp of the line that justifies it.

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: The substance worth remembering: main topics, strongest arguments on each side, and insights or numbers that changed the conversation. Keep it to the transcript's actual content.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: Anything raised but left unresolved. If everything was settled, write 'None.'
